label: Polymarket (public markets)
notes: Read-only: order placement needs an EIP-712 signer (py-clob-client) that this runtime does not have.
terms_note: Public Gamma market-discovery API (no credentials). CLOB trading needs EIP-712 signed orders and L2 HMAC headers, not mapped. Polymarket geoblocks trading in some jurisdictions.

discovery.auth: none (Gamma public); CLOB L1 EIP-712 / L2 HMAC not mapped

me.note: Public API, no credentials: GET /status answers OK.

list_markets.note: Open markets, paged with limit/offset; `query` is not sent. `symbol` is the market slug get_ticker takes; outcomes, outcomePrices and clobTokenIds are JSON-encoded strings.

get_ticker.note: `symbol` is a market slug. Prices are probabilities (0-1) for the market's FIRST outcome (usually Yes); the other outcome trades near 1 - price.

not_offered.get_candles: GET /prices-history (CLOB) returns only {t, p} price points per outcome token, not open/high/low/close candles.
not_offered.get_balances: CLOB balance-allowance needs L2 headers whose POLY_SIGNATURE is 'urlsafeBase64WithPadding(HMAC-SHA256(base64Decode(<clob_api_secret>), message))' (docs); the runtime keys HMAC with the secret's raw text and emits standard base64, so the signature cannot be produced.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /data/orders needs the same L2 HMAC headers keyed by the base64-decoded secret with a URL-safe base64 signature, which the runtime's sign block cannot express.
not_offered.place_order: Orders are EIP-712 typed-data structs signed by the wallet's private key (L1) before being posted with L2 HMAC headers (docs: 'Create an L1 Signature … to attest to ownership of the signer'); the runtime has no wallet signer.
not_offered.cancel_order: DELETE /order needs L2 HMAC headers keyed by the base64-decoded API secret with a URL-safe base64 signature, which the runtime's sign block cannot express.

auth: CLOB private endpoints: L1 EIP-712 wallet signature to derive L2 credentials, then L2 HMAC headers (POLY_ADDRESS, POLY_SIGNATURE, POLY_TIMESTAMP, POLY_API_KEY, POLY_PASSPHRASE).

endpoints.notes: limit, offset, closed (default false), order, ascending; array of Market {id, question, conditionId, slug, outcomes, outcomePrices, volume, active, closed, clobTokenIds, bestBid, bestAsk, lastTradePrice}

reference.limits: Cloudflare-throttled per IP (see docs rate-limits page).

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
